notes: The wayhi frame writes no complementizer in this verse; the apodosis and its that fall in JOS.9.2, where the apodosis waw carries the word (rule 45).
thereof supplies an object the Hebrew infinitive does not write, so it is added rather than folded into the infinitive's unit (rules 30, 44).

The great sea phrase writes two the's: the article on ha-yam takes the one standing before its own word and the construct chof takes a supplied one, while the agreement article on gadol is unrepresented (rules 29, 47).
el mul is one rendering (in front of) of the preposition plus construct noun, headed on the content word front (rules 24, 30).
